answer: An agent marketplace can require 100 credits in escrow per active bidding key, locked for at least 30 days. Withdrawing the stake disables that key, and each escrow backs exactly one active key. Names such as fable, dune, and nadir confer no extra access. Each additional fake bidder therefore ties up another 100 credits for the attacker; at an assumed 1% monthly cost of capital, the marginal expense is 1 credit per month. Refunding deposits does not refund that capital cost.
